<b>Hornet</b> is the mysterious princess-protector of [[Hallownest|Hallownest’s]] ruins, a major character in <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i> and the playable protagonist of <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. She wields a [[Needle]] and thread with deadly prowess.<ref>[https://www.fangamer.com/collections/hollow-knight/products/hollow-knight-switch-ps4-pc-collectors-edition-game Official manual]</ref> Hornet is captured by outsider bugs and brought to their kingdom, [[Pharloom]], but she escapes her cage before arriving at their destination. She then must battle foes and solve mysteries to ascend on a deadly pilgrimage to the kingdom's peak.

== Background ==
Hornet is the daughter of [[Pale King|The Pale King]] and [[Herrah the Beast]], the result of a bargain for [[Herrah the Beast|Herrah]] to become a [[Dreamers|Dreamer]]. Her [[The Pale King|shared father]] with [[the Knight]], [[The Hollow Knight]], and the rest of [[Vessels|The Vessels]] makes her their half sister. 

She was birthed by [[Herrah the Beast|Herrah]], the queen of [[Deepnest]]. Eventually, Hornet was brought to [[White Palace|The White Palace]] and was brought up by [[White Lady|The White Lady]], queen of [[Hallownest]]. At some point, she was trained in [[The Hive]] by [[Hive Queen Vespa]]. 

She was brought to [[Pharloom]] by [[Envoy|veiled bugs]] in a cage covered in a rune. Hornet was intended to be brought to [[Grand Mother Silk]], so the Mother could use Hornet's power.<ref>Hornet dialogue with [[Seamstress]]: <i>"I have seen their Citadel and its state, and I have strong suspicion...They hunt me for my nature. For the Silk produced within my shell. Not for themselves but for the one atop it all."</i></ref>

==In-game Events==
At an unspecified point of time after the [[Radiance]] was slain and the [[Infection]] ended along with it, Hornet was captured by Choirbugs and taken to Pharloom. After the rune on the cage<ref>[[Choral Commandment]]: ''"Full Chamber to the kingdom of the White Wyrm. Claim the Weaver, in half part. Last of their line. Sensed strong with Silk. Resistance anticipated. Quell with rune cage."''</ref> is broken by a [[Silk Fly]], Hornet breaks free and falls down. She begins her journey through the haunted kingdom of Pharloom to find out the purpose behind her capture. 

She discovers [[Bone Bottom]], a small settlement, meets [[Lace]], who she battles, and enters [[The Citadel]] either by activating five bells and defeating the [[Last Judge]], or by defeating [[Phantom]] in [[Bilewater]]. Once in The Citadel, she conducts the Threefold Melody, letting her ascend to [[The Cradle]], where she defeats Lace once again. She then may defeat [[Grand Mother Silk]] and bind her, becoming the new ruler of Pharloom, marking a [[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 1: Weaver Queen|possible ending]]. 

Alternatively, if she completes a large amount of [[Wishes|Wishes]], making her start to care for Pharloom and its people, she may seeks an alternative method, and accepts the [[Silk and Soul]] quest from the [[Caretaker]] to accomplish this. After she completes the quest by gathering materials needed to craft a trap, Hornet then activates it after the battle against Grand Mother Silk, instead of binding her. This causes void to spread into Pharloom, starting [[Act 3]] of the game.{{MissingInfo}}

== Health and Silk ==

=== Health ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:SS Mask.png|center|link=|44x44px]]</div>
[[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Health]] is represented as <b>Masks</b>, shown in the upper-left corner of the screen. Hornet starts the game with 5 Masks and can obtain more by collecting [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]]s. Health is lost by taking damage, either from enemies or from environmental hazards. Health can be regained by the use of the Bind ability, consuming a full Silk spool to regain three masks. This is increased to four with the [[Multibinder]] tool.
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:SS Mask Lifeblood.png|center|link=|48x48px]]</div>
<b>Lifeblood/Plasmium Masks</b>, granted by [[Plasmium Phial|Plasmium Phials]] or killing [[Winged Lifeseed]]s are temporary masks that cannot be normally regenerated by healing, they are removed when sitting on a bench.
</div>

=== Cocoon ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:Map Pin Silk Cocoon.png|link=Cocoon|center|48x48px]]</div>
Upon running out of Health, Hornet will die, leaving behind a [[Cocoon]]. In Normal Mode, she will respawn at the last used [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] or checkpoint, without her [[Rosaries]] and with any [[Spool Fragment|Spool upgrades]] that was previously collected missing. Breaking the Cocoon will bring those back. In {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], the game will instead end and be permanently lost on that save profile, attempting to load said profile will prompt the player to clear it.
</div>

=== Silk ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:Silk_Spool_HUD_Broken_Filled.png|link=Silk|center|60x48px]]</div>
[[Silk]] is represented as a spool below the health indicator. Silk is consumed when using special abilities, including [[Bind]]. Striking enemies with the Needle fills the spool by 1 strand. When there is enough silk to perform a Bind, the symbol representing the side of the spool left to the health indicator is filled.
The Spool can be expanded by collecting [[Spool Fragment]]s. Every two Spool Fragments permanently allows Hornet to store one more strand of Silk.
</div>

== Upgrades and Equipment ==

=== Needle ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:Needle 1 Needle.png|center|100x100px|link=Needle]]</div>
Hornet's main weapon. Can be used to slash or block attacks against [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]]. The [[Needle]] can be used to attack downwards while Hornet is above [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]], spikes or certain objects to bounce off them and gain vertical height, this is called [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bouncing]].
Hornet also uses the needle as a [[Clawline|grappling hook]], and alongside her other abilities.
</div>

=== Tools ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:Tools Prompt.png|center|100x100px|link=Tools]]</div>
Special items classified into red, blue and yellow versions, equipped on a Crest with limited slots for each type. [[Tools]] can be used as throwing weapons or defensive aids and do not cost Silk. They are found throughout Pharloom, and can be changed while sitting on a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]], similar to [[Charms]] in the previous game.
</div>

=== Crests ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:Hunter_Crest_Inventory.png|center|120x120px|link=Crests]]</div>
Special items that alter Hornet's basic attacks. Each [[Crests|Crest]] has its own unique set of needle attacks and a Needle-Bounce, some have additional mechanics.
The Crest also determines the amount of Tools and Skills slots, starting with a different number for each type, and more can be unlocked using [[Memory Locket]]s.<br>
Hornet can aquire new Crests in specifc places in Pharloom, binding the Crest to herself.
Crests can be replaced while sitting on a Bench, with exactly one Crest being equipped at any time. The [[Hunter Crest]] is the default.
</div>

=== Silk Skills ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:Icon_SS_Silkspear_Art.png|center|130x100px|link=Skills_and_Abilities_(Silksong)#Silk_Skills]]</div>
Offensive spells designed by the [[Weavers]] out of Silk. After learning any of them, Hornet can expend some silk to use the [[Skills and Abilities (Silksong)#Silk Skills|Skill]], damaging nearby enemies.
Silk Skill damage scales with needle upgrades, each skill always dealing around three times needle damage.
Like tools, Silk Skills can be equiped and swapped while sitting on a Bench.
</div>

=== Ancestral Arts ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:Icon_SS_Swift_Step_Splash_Clear.png|center|100x100px|link=Skills_and_Abilities_(Silksong)#Ancestral_Arts]]</div>
Weaver abilities that enhance Hornet's movement and aid in her traversal of Pharloom. These are primarily not for combat, but they can still be useful in a fight.
Like Silk Skills, [[Skills and Abilities (Silksong)#Ancestral_Arts|Ancestral Arts]] are found in what remains of the Weavers in Pharloom, mainly in the [[Weaver Burial Spire]]s.
</div>

=== Abilities ===
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px auto; align-items: center;">
<div style="margin: 0 0 1.5rem;">[[File:Drifter's_Cloak.png|center|100x100px|link=Skills_and_Abilities_(Silksong)#Other_Abilities]]</div>
[[Skills_and_Abilities_(Silksong)#Other_Abilities |Other abilities]] Hornet may gain throughout her journey, helping with movement, combat or progression, they can be aquired in a variety of ways.
</div>

== Trivia ==
* On Silksong's Steam page, Hornet is called a "Princess Knight".<ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/app/1030300/Hollow_Knight_Silksong/ Silksong Steam page]</ref>
* Hornet has a love of fluffy bugs, as evidenced by various entries in her [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]].<ref>[[Mossgrub|Mossgrub's]] Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"If not for the spikes, I would think it an appealing bug."</i></ref><ref>[[Furm|Furm's]] Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"I would very much like to feel their soft fur, if only they weren't so hostile."</i></ref><ref>[[Huge Flea|Huge Flea's]] Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"I would not have guessed so large and marvellous a flea existed. I am pleased it saw sense before I had to strike a killing blow."</i></ref>
* Regardless of whether she is imprisoned by them, Hornet shows a disgust toward the flies of [[the Slab]].<ref>[[Wardenfly]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Disgusting both in manner and stench. I feel no remorse to see them felled."</i></ref><ref>[[Scabfly]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Foul creatures birthed into servitude. Their plight elicits no sympathy from me."</i></ref><ref>[[Freshfly]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"The less these gruesome bugs breed, the better."</i></ref>
* At some point in the past, Hornet had mates.<ref>[[Great Conchflies]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's journal]] entry: <i>"(…) I once sought similar union, but of my own mates none could match my lifespan."</i></ref>
* Hornet's cloak has a deeper red colour in-game than the colour of her extracted sprites. This is due to the game's lighting making her cloak appear more saturated in most areas. Her sprites use the same colour red as her sprites in <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>.
